faq.question: Do I need a computer or to install any software?

faq.answer: You keep entering sales and payments. Entries wait on the phone and are sent automatically when the connection is back.
faq.question: What happens if the internet goes down?

faq.answer: No. Records are kept in the cloud; when you sign in on a new phone, everything is right where you left it.
faq.question: If I lose my phone, do I lose my data?

faq.answer: Messages are sent under the product's shared sender name, and your shop's name appears in the text. You don't need to file any application or paperwork. SMS packs are sold separately.
faq.question: Whose name are the SMS reminders sent under?

faq.answer: Reminders are debt notifications and contain no advertising. By default, the same customer gets one at most once every 7 days, never on Sundays or outside 10:00–18:00.
faq.question: Will my customers complain that the messages are spam?

faq.answer: We import your customer list together during setup. Customers added later can be entered one by one in the app.
